summary: Avoid rewriting unchanged peer projection metadata during replication and update batch watermarks in place

schema.detail: Uses the existing meta primary key; no schema migration.

rules.detail: Replication admission and batch watermark calculations are unchanged, including sealing recovery frontier repair.

compatibility.detail: Stored metadata and replication wire values are unchanged. Existing metadata rowids are retained when values change.

downtime.detail: No coordinated rollout or downtime required.

recovery.detail: Existing transaction boundaries, rollback behavior and recovery watermark adjustments are preserved. Peer success timestamps still update on every successful receive.
